title: Clinical Study of CHT105 Injection in the Treatment of Relapsed/Refractory Autoimmune Diseases
off: An Open-Label, Single-Arm Clinical Study to Evaluate the Safety and Efficacy of Allogeneic CAR-T Cell Injection Targeting CD19/CD70 (CHT105) in Patients With Relapsed/Refractory Autoimmune Diseases
collabs: The First Affiliated Hospital of Nanchang University
summary:
Primary Objective: To evaluate the safety and efficacy of CHT105 Injection in subjects with relapsed/refractory autoimmune diseases.

Secondary Objective:To evaluate the pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) characteristics of CHT105 Injection.

Indication: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)

primary.m: Types, severity, and frequency of adverse events (AEs)
primary.tf: Throughout the study period, up to 52 weeks.

primary.m: Complete response rate and partial response rate
